project_name: Duos Edge AI Amarillo Edge Data Center
aliases: Duos Edge AI second EDC in Amarillo
status_detail: Company announced March 19, 2026 deployment of its second Amarillo edge data center on Potter County land; local news reported Potter County commissioners approved a five-year parking-lot lease in January 2026 and the center was expected to be operational in coming months.
notes: Official company release identifies Potter County land and a Tier 3 carrier-neutral EDC; news provides county lease approval details. Capacity not disclosed.

project_name: Lead Capital / Maachi Presidio Data Center Complex

notes: Early-stage local-news lead; include because it names proponents, land request, 100 MW size, and public board presentation.
